name: personHashedUrl
label: Person URL
help: URL accepted by the Sales Navigator opener, including an alert subject URL.

name: listId
label: List ID
help: Optional string ID of an owned custom lead list; other targets return listNotFound. Current limitation: If you have more than 10 lead lists, if the menu hides this list, the call fails with unexpectedError; the lead may be saved but not added to it.
